# NFL Daily — 2026-08-10 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- 08/10: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil (torn triceps) will have surgery and is expected to miss significant time, possibly the season; Brandon Coleman takes over at left tackle. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574125/commanders-star-lt-laremy-tunsil-triceps-surgery)
- 08/10: Patriots TE Hunter Henry signs a two-year extension worth up to $20M, with $14.5M guaranteed. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574198/sources-patriots-te-hunter-henry-agree-2-year-extension)
- 08/09: QB Teddy Bridgewater retires from the NFL for a second time; Lions sign veteran Josh Dobbs as his backup-QB replacement. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49568593/teddy-bridgewater-leaves-lions-likely-retire-again-coach-says)
- 08/10: Lions lose starting C Cade Mays (fractured wrist, out 8-10 weeks) and RB Isiah Pacheco (MCL sprain) to injuries suffered in the same practice window. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574921/lions-cade-mays-wrist-expected-miss-8-10-weeks)
- 08/09: Panthers QB Haynes King (hamstring) ruled out for next Saturday's preseason game; Carolina signs Kyle Trask as its third quarterback. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49567742/panthers-sign-kyle-trask-qb3-haynes-king-injury)
- 08/10: Bears WR Luther Burden III (groin) expected to miss the rest of the preseason but targeting a Week 1 return. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574301/sources-bears-luther-burden-iii-expected-miss-preseason)
- 08/10: Chiefs OC Eric Bieniemy returned to the team after a two-week absence following the shooting of his wife; his son has been charged in the shooting. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49574977/oc-eric-bieniemy-returns-chiefs-shooting-wife)
- 08/10: Free-agent CB Terrion Arnold visiting the Seahawks and Saints as teams weigh a February incident that resulted in felony charges, including kidnapping and armed robbery. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/terrion-arnold-free-agent-visiting-with-seahawks-and-saints/)
